links.comparator_used: No retrieved context (model's own knowledge) on previously incorrect items; also compared gold-source abstract, top-3 semantically ranked PubMed abstracts, and random abstracts
links.outcome: Accuracy on previously incorrect items after retrieval-augmented prompting
links.effect: Gold-source abstract raised accuracy to 0.79; top 3 PubMed abstracts (ranked by semantic relevance) improved accuracy to 0.23; random abstracts reduced accuracy (0.10, within temperature variation). Effects mirrored in GPT-4o-mini.
links.tradeoff: Benefit depends on retrieval quality: top-3 retrieval gave only modest gains (0.23) compared with the gold abstract (0.79), and random abstracts lowered accuracy.
links.quote: When we incorporate retrieval-augmented prompting, providing the gold-source abstract raises accuracy on previously incorrect items to 0.79; providing top 3 PubMed abstracts (ranked by semantic relevance) improves accuracy to 0.23, while random abstracts reduce accuracy (0.10, within temperature variation).
